items.title: Meet Wall Street’s Safe Passive Income Dividend Stocks: 4 Companies That Keep Paying Through Downturns
items.summary: When recessions hit, some companies keep raising the check anyway. Three consumer giants and one regulated utility did it through 2008 and 2020, yet each carries a hidden risk that could change how safe your income really is.

items.title: Unilever and Diageo Took Different Paths in 2026. One Looks Better for Income
items.summary: Two British consumer giants, two very different years for shareholders. One slashed its payout while the other kept raising it, and the cheaper stock is not the safer bet. Which one belongs in a retiree's income portfolio?

items.title: How Investors May Respond To McCormick (MKC) Dividend Increase
items.summary: McCormick & Company’s board approved an increase in the quarterly dividend from US$0.48 to US$0.51 per share, payable on 11 January 2027 to shareholders of record on 28 December 2026, extending a track record of 103 years of uninterrupted dividends and 41 straight years of dividend growth.
